items.title: Southern (SO) Stock Looks About Right On Current Earnings
items.summary: Southern has delivered steady gains for long term holders. With fresh spending plans and funding moves in the headlines, the live question is whether the current share price is still supported by its earnings power. With the stock around US$94.11, investors are increasingly focused on how much of that tag is tied to today’s profit base versus expectations about what comes next. items.title: These 4 Utility Stocks Pay Dividends While AI Drives Electricity Demand Higher

items.title: $75,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Pay More Than $1,700 a Year Across 5 Sectors

items.title: Investors Buy Unusually Large LEAP Options in Southeastern Utility, Southern Company
